capabilities.label: Table-stakes across all
capabilities.detail: product catalog with variants/options, cart & checkout, coupon/promotion engine, multiple payment gateways + digital wallets, order & inventory management, tax & shipping calculation, SEO tooling, app/extension marketplace. Everyone now offers abandoned-cart recovery, reviews/ratings, and customer accounts.
features: app/extension marketplace. Everyone now offers abandoned-cart recovery

capabilities.label: Headless/composable is universal but delivered differently
capabilities.detail: — Shopify (Storefront API + Hydrogen/Oxygen), BigCommerce (MACH "Open SaaS" + Catalyst), Salesforce (SCAPI/OCAPI + PWA Kit), Adobe (GraphQL + PWA Studio + App Builder), commercetools (API-first, no monolith) vs WooCommerce (REST/Store API on open-source WordPress). commercetools + BigCommerce are the explicit MACH-certified pure-composable plays; Shopify/Salesforce/Adobe bolt headless onto a full suite.
features: commercetools (API-first, no monolith) vs WooCommerce (REST/Store API on open-source WordPress). commercetools + BigCommerce are the explicit MACH-certified pure-composable plays; Shopify/Salesforce/Adobe bolt headless onto a full suite.

capabilities.label: AI is the current battleground
capabilities.detail: — Shopify Sidekick/Magic + Shopify Audiences, Salesforce Einstein + Agentforce (agentic commerce), Adobe Sensei (Live Search/Recommendations/GenAI), BigCommerce AI merchandising, commercetools AI agents with human-in-the-loop. AI search, personalized recommendations, generative content converging as standard.
features: commercetools AI agents with human-in-the-loop. AI search

capabilities.label: Native B2B + unified B2B/DTC is a major differentiator
capabilities.detail: — Shopify B2B (same store), Salesforce B2B Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, BigCommerce B2B Edition all offer company accounts, custom catalogs/price lists, quotes, purchase orders, payment terms. WooCommerce relies on third-party extensions.
features: BigCommerce B2B Edition all offer company accounts
payment terms. WooCommerce relies on third-party extensions.

capabilities.label: Internationalization ships natively on the enterprise tier
capabilities.detail: — Shopify Markets, Adobe multi-store, Salesforce multi-site (multi-currency/multi-language/geo-routing/duties/tax); WooCommerce and BigCommerce lean on extensions/multi-storefront.
features: Salesforce multi-site (multi-currency/multi-language/geo-routing/duties/tax); WooCommerce and BigCommerce lean on extensions/multi-storefront.

capabilities.label: Business-model spectrum
capabilities.detail: Shopify & BigCommerce = hosted SaaS (fast time-to-market, app ecosystem); Salesforce & Adobe = enterprise suites tied to their broader clouds (Customer 360 / Experience Cloud) with OMS + heavy customization; commercetools = pure API-first composable; WooCommerce = open-source, self-hosted, maximum ownership + WordPress plugin breadth.
features: Shopify & BigCommerce = hosted SaaS (fast time-to-market, app ecosystem); Salesforce & Adobe = enterprise suites tied to their broader clouds (Customer 360 / Experience Cloud) with OMS + heavy customization; commercetools = pure API-first composable; WooCommerce = open-source

capabilities.label: Distinct differentiators
capabilities.detail: Shopify's Shop Pay network + Payments + Functions · BigCommerce's no-transaction-fees + Feedonomics + multi-storefront · Salesforce's Order Management + Omnichannel Inventory + Agentforce · Adobe's Multi-Source Inventory + Page Builder + deepest native B2B (negotiable quotes/requisition lists) · WooCommerce's open-source ownership + Subscriptions/Memberships/Bookings suite + 59k-plugin ecosystem.

capabilities.label: Recurring/subscription commerce
capabilities.detail: native/first-party for WooCommerce (Subscriptions) and Shopify (Subscription APIs + Shop Pay); Salesforce/Adobe/BigCommerce typically via add-ons/partners (Recharge, etc.).
